name: Seal of Alysrazor survives a level-up instead of being unlearned (#5418, #5473, #5201)
contract: #5418, #5473, #5201: Seal of Alysrazor 800196 is a Pyromancer class ability, the rank-1 root of the 802819/802820/802821/802822 chain (AscensionSpellProgressionData.h) and the reference bootstrap (rev_1787754600000000000.sql:155) sets its required_level at 5, matching the level-2 entry of the same chain in spell_ranks (rev_20260831_01_local_spell_progression.sql). It was present only in AscensionCompatData::LegacyGeneratedClassSpells, not in ClassSpells, so AscensionClassService::currentGrantAllows (AscensionCompat.cpp) rejected it and SynchronizeProgression::reconcile removed it on every login, level-up, talent-rank apply and spec switch. The fix adds {24, 5, 800196} to ClassSpells. Learn it directly (bypassing the trainer flow, which this read-only investigation could not locate), cross a level boundary through native GiveLevel, and confirm it is still known.

steps.label: Seal of Alysrazor is still known after level-up
Seal of Alysrazor is still known after a second level-up
